title: Notification on E-Payment received and processed Via E-payment
text: Department of Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health issued the notification on the payment for the application of the Import Health Certificate – IHC and issuance of recommendations since 1 April 2025, processed manual by using FDA (Yangon branch office’s bank account), Now the payment system was changed to E-Payment system since 28 April 2025.
